title: Black Ball Cornflower - 2x Plug Plants - Pollinator Friendly
description:
2x Black Ball Variety Plug Plants


 Centaurea 'Black Ball' - The Most Dramatic Cornflower for Your Garden!
 


 Transform your garden with the intense, velvety colour of Cornflower 'Black Ball'. Forget the classic blues – these stunning annuals produce a profusion of deep, dark crimson-black flowers that are guaranteed to turn heads and add a touch of gothic drama to your borders and pots.
 


 Easy to grow and adored by bees, 'Black Ball' is a must-have for any gardener looking to make a bold statement from late spring right through the summer. They are also one of the best cut flowers you can grow, with long, strong stems perfect for bringing their unique beauty indoors.


 What You'll Receive:
 


 2x Healthy, Well-Rooted Plug Plants.
 


 Our plug plants are grown by professionals and will have a strong root system, ready for you to pot on or plant out.
 


 They are carefully packaged in protective blister packs or secure trays to ensure they arrive in perfect condition.
